steps.prompt: When you finish a piece of writing, what do you check before you hand it in?

cards.title: Revise, then edit
cards.body: Revising changes the big things: the thesis, the order, the evidence, the explanations. Editing fixes the small things: words, grammar, punctuation. Revise first; there is no point polishing a sentence you will cut.

cards.title: Review in passes
cards.body: Pass 1: structure (hook, thesis, body paragraphs, conclusion). Pass 2: support (evidence and explanations). Pass 3: style (formal, precise, concise). Pass 4: conventions (grammar, spelling, punctuation). Pass 5: read it aloud.

cards.title: The final essay checklist
cards.body: Your final essay comes with a checklist. Some items tick themselves as you write (“checked for you”); you tick the others after checking them yourself. Today, practise on Jordan’s essay.

prompts: Which kind of problem was easiest to spot in Jordan’s essay? Which was hardest?
Which pass will help your own essay most?
